name: Abinadab
bio: Abinadab was Jesse's second son, David's older brother. When Samuel was anointing a new king among Jesse's sons, Abinadab passed before him, but the LORD said he had not been chosen (1 Samuel 16:8). He later joined his eldest brother Eliab in Saul's army, facing the Philistines at the Valley of Elah (1 Samuel 17:13).
